definitions.explanation: The legal status of holding citizenship in a country other than the one being discussed, typically Japan.

examples.japanese: {外国籍|がいこくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of residents with foreign nationality is increasing.

examples.japanese: {外国籍|がいこくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}け→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ます。
examples.english: Even people with foreign nationality can open an account.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外国籍|がいこくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}{教育|きょういく}→日本語教育：25806_nihongokyouiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: This city provides Japanese language education support to children with foreign nationality as well.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧ (foreign country) and {籍|せき} (register, nationality). This is the standard administrative and media term for describing people who hold citizenship of another country. It is used in government documents, news reports, and official contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外国籍|がいこくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧: residents of foreign nationality
- {外国籍|がいこくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}→労働者：23971_roudousha⟧: workers of foreign nationality
- {外国籍|がいこくせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold foreign nationality
- {外国籍|がいこくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧: children with foreign nationality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧: foreigner — refers to the person, while {外国籍|がいこくせき} refers to the legal status
- ⟦{国籍|こくせき}→国籍：02755_kokuseki⟧: nationality; citizenship — the general term without specifying foreign
- ⟦{二重国籍|にじゅうこくせき}→二重国籍：23951_nijuukokuseki⟧: dual nationality — holding citizenship in two countries
